svg.title: Area under a parametric curve
svg.desc: Curve x=t, y=t(2-t) for t zero to two, shaded area under curve evaluated as integral of y dx/dt equals four thirds.

g.text: Pearson Edexcel IAL Mathematics • pure mathematics
For a curve traced once with x increasing, area = ∫ y (dx/dt) dt.
Curve stays above the axis on 0 ≤ t ≤ 2.
